headlines.title: $400,000 in PepsiCo and Kimberly-Clark Pays $17,845 a Year in Dividends
headlines.summary: Two consumer staples giants have raised their dividends for 54 straight years, yet one is stalling in North America and the other just took on a mountain of Kenvue debt. Which risk should a retiree worry about more?

headlines.title: How PepsiCo Is Targeting GLP-1 Users
headlines.summary: PepsiCo’s Mark Kirkham speaks with the WSJ Leadership Institute’s Megan Graham at the WSJLI CMO Council Summit in New York about a new market for the company’s beverage business.

headlines.title: How PepsiCo Turns Fandom Into Brand Loyalty | WSJ Leadership Institute
headlines.summary: PepsiCo Beverages U.S. CMO Mark Kirkham shares how the beverage giant chooses the athletes and influencers it collaborates with, how it is using AI to drive the reach of its campaigns and the creation of its innovative content studio called "the blender.

headlines.title: KFC drops Pepsi in the U.S., but not everywhere
headlines.summary: After nearly 40 years, the fast-food chain is making a major change to its beverage lineup.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Expanding DRIPS by Pepsi with Proprietary Syrup Lineup and Concentrated Bases
headlines.summary: PepsiCo is expanding DRIPS by Pepsi, its crafted beverage platform, with the launch of a proprietary syrup lineup and concentrated bases. Introducing DRIPS by Pepsi Signature Mixes, the first standalone syrups innovation from PepsiCo designed for scalability and menu versatility, and Concentrated Bases to simplify beverage creation.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
